messages:
zara: Quick conv about an emerging field ask: several customers want a formal 'preserve customer network' upgrade lane so we never reassign their CIDRs or peer IPs during upgrades. Need product + tech callouts.

kevin: Do we have an example manifest from field? that helps scope the installer change.

zara: Posted one sample from Skylark: 
```yaml
networkUpgrade:
  mode: preserve
  reservedCidrs: [10.50.5.0/24]
  preservePeers: true
  offline: true
```

anya: High-level tradeoffs: guaranteeing preservation means keeping allocation metadata outside ephemeral nodes (PV or external KV) and avoiding any automated rebind logic. That reduces flexibility for autoscaling and node replacement.

luca: For BGP peers we also need to persist session IPs and certs so routers don't tear down. That implies a migration step that writes preserved entries back after the control plane is upgraded.

kevin: Proposal: two lanes. 1) fast (default) - best-effort rebind allowed, current SLOs. 2) preserve (opt-in) - installer honors reservedCidrs, uses `--preserve-network-state` flag, and runs a migration job. Documented operator window required.

zara: Launch criteria idea: installer accepts reservedCidrs, preflight check to validate no overlap, migration job implemented, runbook + rollback doc, and two pilot validations.

anya: Implementation notes: Add `redwoodctl preflight --check-reserved 10.50.5.0/24` which fails with guidance if overlap detected. Store allocations in PV or external KV (Vault/Consul) with no TTL for preserve lane. Add audit event when operator reserves/releases a range.

luca: UX/field: a single toggle in the console and clear copy: "Preserve customer network (may increase upgrade time; operator approval required)". Also telemetry opt-in snippet for customers to confirm peers stayed up post-upgrade.

kevin: SLA expectations: for preserve lane, warn customers upgrades may take 15-30m and require an operator approval window. Keep default lane SLOs unchanged.

zara: Also need airgap checklist: cert continuity (KMS/HSM options), manual migration commands, and a sample privacy-friendly telemetry payload.

ops-bot: Reminder: Pilot slot available 2026-06-03 09:00 UTC. Reply with +1 to claim.

anya: Action items: kevin -> draft PR for `--preserve-network-state` and preflight (owner: kevin, due: EOW). luca -> sample migration playbook + airgap checklist (owner: luca, due: Tue). zara -> consolidate launch criteria and pilot list (owner: zara, due: Wed).

kevin: I'll include a preflight error message example and a reclamation workflow where operator must run `redwoodctl network release --confirm` to unreserve.

luca: We'll also add an audit log line `network.reserve` and `network.release` for compliance.

zara: We'll review pilot results before gating Private GA on this. If pilots expose gaps we'll ship preserve lane as opt-in alpha first. Thanks all :thumbsup:
